title: Kitten
description: NATIONAL BESTSELLER • An enchanting debut novel about a young woman whose growing obsession with her boyfriend’s cat opens new possibilities for her life - but not without threatening to unravel it.Abound in wit and restraint, Kitten explores the funny yet unsettling complexities of modern love… . A fearless debut! - Weike Wang, author of ChemistryYu’s novel is both a kind of Gen Z parable of existential nihilism ...
